  • Strong experience with WAG manifolds or subsea production systems preferred
  • Certified Welding Inspector (CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2 or equivalent CWI certification)
  • NDT Level 2 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI required)
  • Extensive experience with CRA materials and advanced welding processes
  • Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese is advantageous)

title: Stadium Guest Operations Manager
description:
Stadium Guest Operations Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/ VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Resumo do cargo

A pessoa Analista Fiscal será responsável por diagnosticar a base tributária da empresa, revisar e ajustar setups de impostos, e garantir conformidade durante a transição da Reforma Tributária, incluindo as novas exigências de apuração assistida previstas para 2026. Atuará com autonomia e visão crítica, revisando procedimentos, fortalecendo controles e propondo melhorias que promovam economia tributária e aderência às legislações vigentes.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão :

Atuar como assessoria tributária ao time comercial e áreas internas, oferecendo suporte técnico em dúvidas fiscais, participação em propostas comerciais quando necessário e conduzindo treinamentos específicos da área fiscal para diferentes públicos internos.

Garantir a gestão estratégica e o compliance tributário em nível federal, estadual e municipal, analisando cenários complexos, revisando procedimentos e propondo melhorias que assegurem conformidade e maximizem eficiência.

Acompanhar de perto a Reforma Tributária, mantendo-se atualizado(a) pelas fontes oficiais (como Portal Gov.br), e liderando a adaptação dos processos internos ao cronograma de transição, incluindo a revisão de setups de impostos nos sistemas (ERP) e a preparação para novas exigências de apuração assistida a partir de 2026.

Conduzir estudos de planejamento tributário, identificando oportunidades de otimização da carga tributária e recuperação de créditos fiscais (por exemplo, PIS / COFINS, ICMS), sempre alinhados às políticas internas e à legislação vigente.

Apoiar e revisar as obrigações acessórias, orientando analistas júnior e pleno em entregas como SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DCTFWeb, EFD-Reinf, PER / DCOMP, entre outras, assegurando qualidade, consistência e cumprimento de prazos.

Dar suporte direto a auditorias internas e externas, preparando informações, esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas e contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos fiscais.

Atuar como referência técnica, apoiando na priorização de demandas, liderando projetos de melhoria contínua, mentorando profissionais mais juniores e compartilhando boas práticas.

Colaborar com áreas parceiras (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Tecnologia da Informação, Operações, Vendas, etc.) para garantir que os processos e sistemas reflitam corretamente as regras tributárias, especialmente no contexto da Reforma Tributária e de mudanças de legislação.

Você é uma pessoa profissional organizada, analítica e orientada a resultados, que gosta de trabalhar com temas complexos e transformá-los em soluções práticas para o negócio.

Você pensa de forma estruturada e sistêmica, conectando impactos tributários, contábeis e operacionais, e toma decisões com base em dados e em uma análise cuidadosa dos riscos.

Você se comunica com clareza e empatia, adapta a linguagem ao público (técnico ou não técnico) e construí parcerias de confiança com áreas internas e externas.

Para este cargo, você precisará :

Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração (preferencialmente) ou Direito.

Experiência sólida em departamento fiscal, atuando com foco em tributos indiretos e operações de alta complexidade.

Domínio de impostos indiretos e obrigações acessórias, incluindo, mas não se limitando a : SPED Fiscal; EFD Contribuições; EFD-Reinf; DCTFWeb; PER / DCOMP e demais rotinas fiscais relacionadas.

Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal, com capacidade de interpretação e aplicação prática no dia a dia.

Experiência com conciliações contábeis relacionadas a impostos indiretos, garantindo a aderência entre fiscal, contábil e sistemas.

Atualização constante e conhecimento considerável sobre a Reforma Tributária, seus impactos práticos, cronograma de transição e novas obrigações.

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, influenciar decisões com argumentos técnicos e gerenciar múltiplas demandas com prioridade e organização.

Local de trabalho :

Sorocaba, SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam :

Atuação prévia em projetos de implantação ou adequação à Reforma Tributária.

Excel avançado.

Experiência com ERPs integrados, preferencialmente Oracle, e familiaridade com parametrização fiscal.

Conhecimentos em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de análise de dados.

Pós-graduação ou MBA na área tributária, contábil ou afins.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você :

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. description:
An Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that a team’s day-to-day activities run smoothly and align with the organization’s strategic objectives. This position is responsible for overseeing operational processes , ensuring that resources—such as personnel, budgets, equipment, and time—are used as efficiently and effectively as possible. By setting and maintaining high company standards , an Operations Manager works to consistently exceed objectives, improve productivity, and foster a culture of excellence.

The role often requires coordinating between frontline employees and senior leadership , serving as a critical link to ensure that communication flows clearly in both directions. This includes translating high-level business goals into practical, actionable plans for teams, as well as escalating operational challenges to upper management when needed.

Typical duties may involve developing and optimizing workflows , managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing process improvements to boost efficiency and quality. An Operations Manager also plays an active role in problem-solving , anticipating risks, and addressing issues before they escalation, ensuring smooth operations even under tight deadlines or high-pressure situations.

In addition, this role often includes training, mentoring, and performance evaluation to help employees prioritize tasks, meet individual and team goals, and contribute to a positive, high-performance workplace culture.

Success as an Operations Manager requires a balance of strategic thinking, strong leadership, adaptability, and excellent organizational skills , along with the ability to make data-driven decisions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Descrição da oferta de emprego

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.
  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you’ll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won’t just review what AI produces — you’ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application. Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.

  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's and/or Master’s degree in any field.

  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.

title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

A Social Media Manager is responsible for building, managing, and expanding a company’s presence across multiple social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, and emerging channels. This role goes beyond simply posting content—it involves crafting a cohesive brand voice , designing and executing data-driven content strategies , and ensuring consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Daily responsibilities often include planning editorial calendars , creating engaging text, image, and video content, scheduling and publishing posts, and actively interacting with followers to foster an engaged online community. A Social Media Manager also monitors industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity to adapt strategies proactively.

Equally important is performance analysis —tracking metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions to assess campaign effectiveness and inform future decisions. This requires proficiency with analytics tools, an understanding of paid advertising, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvements.

Success in this position demands strong communication skills, creativity, adaptability, and a deep understanding of digital marketing principles . A great Social Media Manager not only amplifies brand awareness but also drives audience loyalty and contributes directly to achieving broader business goals.

ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad search, application, and acceptance process by connecting international students, recruitment partners, and educational institutions on one intuitive and personalized platform. ApplyBoard is a mission-driven, hyper-growth organization. It has been attracting dedicated individuals for more than eight years who are inspired every day to break down barriers to international education and take their careers to new heights at a company that will invest in their career growth. Our six core values are our compass in our mission to Educate the World and the foundation of our unique company culture. As an organization built on a foundation of diversity, it’s important that our team members are representative of the students from more than 150 countries that we support.

The Opportunity

As a Service Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of 20-30 Platinum (Tier 4) Recruitment Partners (RPs), providing them with end-to-end service and support. As a single point of contact for your accounts’ customer service needs, your goal is to provide timely and impactful resolutions of escalated issues while fostering a positive business relationship. You will do this through proactive account and application level analysis, and by educating your accounts on how best to leverage ApplyBoard products and services. You will also use your close relationship with key accounts to serve as a voice for our customers, providing regular feedback and contributing to strategic discussions that impact our business.

What you will be doing everyday

Customer Relationship Management

  • Be a single point of contact with the assigned RPs, providing dedicated, real-time support through their preferred channel(s) (i.e., email, WhatsApp, phone, live chat, etc.).

  • Help to grow your accounts’ business with ApplyBoard by establishing a trusted relationship.

  • Work closely with your accounts and foster regular engagement via weekly/bi-weekly calls, reports, and updates.

  • Conduct monthly governance meetings with RPs to review performance and address concerns.

Proactive Support and Engagement

  • Provide your RPs with proactive, outbound service by actively monitoring their applications in-funnel and taking part in customer engagement and follow-up campaigns.

  • Prioritize incoming support requests from your accounts in order to meet SLA.

  • Maintain your customer portfolio with relevant events, challenges, and preferences so that account health and status are discernible “at a glance”.

Product Knowledge

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of the company’s products and services to provide accurate information and support.

  • Stay updated with new product releases, features, and company policies.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements in all customer interactions.

  • Maintain confidentiality of customer information and adhere to data protection regulations.

Team Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with team to ensure timely execution of all tasks.

  • Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects ensuring they meet established standards and deadlines

  • Continuously update partners on any updates to SOPs and requirements.

  • Assist management in identifying bottlenecks and gaps in cross-team processes and policies. Contribute to the development and implementation of strategies that enhance interdepartmental efficiency and collaboration.

Training & Development

  • Represent the ApplyBoard brand to promote our platform and services to RPs. Train and guide RPs to improve the quality and volume of international applicants.

  • Aid, advise, or lead on projects as assigned by your leader to improve CX processes, tools, or training to improve customer outcomes.

  • Occasionally assist with training new team members and ensuring training materials are updated

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of new processes, systems and best practices in education credentials.

  • Participate and complete all training programs ensuring continuous development of skills and knowledge relevant to the role.

What you bring to the table

  • 1-3 years of customer service experience

  • 2+ years experience with ApplyBoard, preferably within the Customer Experience (CX) team

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent

    An associate's or Bachelor's degree is an asset

  • Experience training and/or developing training/process documentation resources

  • Strong understanding of ApplyBoard platform and application processes/policies

  • Proficiency in proofreading/editing text to ensure spelling and grammatical correctness

  • Flexible to “Work from Office” per team policies

  • Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate internal and external stakeholder needs

  • Strong analytical abilities, detail-oriented and high level of accuracy

  • Working knowledge of Google spreadsheets, Microsoft Word and Gmail

  • Adept researching and problem-solving capabilities

  • Someone who thrives in a collaborative, teamwork environment

  • Aptitude for prioritizing tasks with an attention to detail to ensure information accuracy

  • Ability to work in a flexible, fast-paced environment to meet multiple deadlines and adapt to new policies and procedures

  • An ability to work cross-functionally to ensure application processing consistency and efficiency

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills under ambiguous circumstances to ensure we provide the best outcome for our students while maintaining integrity with our partner relationships

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and verbal and written communication skills.

About ApplyBoard

ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access the best education. With more than 1,000,000 students from over 150 countries helped with their journey in less than a decade, we are just getting started.

ApplyBoard’s global team assists students and our 1,500+ partner institutions by empowering the international student sector with innovative technology and insights. As a five-time consecutive Deloitte Fast 50 and Fast 500 ranked company, ApplyBoard keeps international students at the heart of everything we do.

Thank you for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard Team and being part of our mission to Educate the World. While we are lucky to attract a high level of interest in each of our roles, only qualified applicants will be contacted and selected for an interview.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, and/or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

ApplyBoard welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

Accreditation Operations Senior Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high‑quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise daytoday accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue‑based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to postevent reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Coordenador de Operações
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

É responsável por coordenar, supervisionar e orientar as equipes de segurança, garantindo o cumprimento dos procedimentos e normas estabelecidas.

Ele realiza a elaboração das escalas de trabalho, alocação e reposição de pessoal conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Realiza o monitoramento e controle dos serviços em campo, com visitas periódicas aos postos de trabalho para assegurar a conformidade com os procedimentos operacionais padrão (POP) e normas de segurança vigentes.

Organiza treinamentos periódicos para a capacitação e atualização dos colaboradores, além de avaliar o desempenho da equipe e propor ações voltadas à melhoria contínua.

Gerencia o uso e manutenção dos equipamentos de segurança, como sistemas de vigilância, body cams e rádios, garantindo a operação adequada dos dispositivos e o correto armazenamento dos dados coletados.

Responsabiliza-se pelo controle dos materiais, equipamentos e uniformes, solicitando reposições quando necessário, bem como pela gestão dos custos operacionais e colaboração na elaboração de orçamentos.

Mantém contato frequente com os clientes para assegurar a satisfação com os serviços prestados, além de resolver questões e conflitos relacionados à operação.

Zela pelo cumprimento das legislações trabalhistas, normas de segurança privada e políticas internas da empresa, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e prestando contas à diretoria.

Coordena o gerenciamento de incidentes, investigando ocorrências, registrando relatórios e conduzindo ações corretivas, além de organizar respostas rápidas em situações de emergência.

Fornece suporte administrativo, controlando a documentação relacionada à operação, contratos e licenças, e apoiando processos de contratação, desligamento e avaliação de colaboradores.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Formação superior em Administração, Gestão de Segurança, Engenharia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de equipes operacionais, preferencialmente no setor de segurança privada.
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas e legislações relacionadas à segurança privada e trabalhista.
  • Habilidade para liderar, motivar e desenvolver equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de planejamento, organização e gerenciamento de recursos.
  • Experiência em controle de custos e elaboração de orçamentos operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento, equipamentos de segurança e tecnologias associadas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para negociação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo turnos, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Proatividade, capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas e trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão, softwares de controle operacional e pacote Office.
  • Carteira de habilitação válida (diferencial, caso haja necessidade de deslocamento entre unidades).

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 37,85 p/dia
  • Vale Transporte

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Overlay Cluster Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset.
  • Availability to travel as needed
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Senior Manager, Special Events

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

  • Official Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE

Education
  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large‑scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies Strategic & Operational Excellence
  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Overview:

We are seeking a Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear Specialist to join the Technical Services Division/ High Voltage Equipment Unit (HVEU). The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support the safe and reliable operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks.   • Provide technical expertise on troubleshooting failures, repairs, and evaluating if the equipment is designed to meet its intended or existing service conditions.
  • Provide technical engineering input on repair details and offers onsite technical support, especially for critical equipment for the process.
  • Provide engineering input for switchgear work packages to ensure Saudi Aramco standards and material specifications are followed.
  • Review and update company standards and be familiar with international standards.

As a successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years’ experience of operations and maintenance experience directly working with MV switchgear/control gear.
  • You will have In-depth knowledge, experience, and recognition as a switchgear specialist including membership of international engineering bodies and contribution at international conferences.
  • Background in the oil and gas industry or equipment manufacturers is a plus.
  • Professional Engineer certification such as chartership or PE is a plus.
  • You will have a working Knowledge of ANSI and IEC designed switchgear, breaker design (including mechanisms and interruption technology - vacuum, air, compressed air, SF-6), motor control gears, motor contactors, and pad-mounted SF-6 equipment.
  • You will have the ability to multi-task and manage changing priorities and seek opportunities to improve results and processes proactively, contributing to the goals, safety, and profitability of the company.
  • You will be able to integrate and quickly applying newly acquired technical information
  • You will have strong speaking, writing, and customer service skills.
  • You will also be able to complete daily work activities with limited supervision and able to work cooperatively in a team environment.

Work location: Within Saudi Arabia: On-Site

description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Líder de Consultoria e Processos

Como um contribuinte fundamental para a excelência operacional, o Consultor de Processos & Melhoria Contínua (CI) conduz iniciativas impactantes de melhoria de processos em toda a organização. Atuando como um assessor de confiança, este cargo é responsável por padronizar, implementar e otimizar processos críticos para aumentar a eficiência e o desempenho. Utilizando sua expertise em melhoria contínua, o consultor garante que as soluções estejam alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais e entreguem resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis, promovendo uma cultura de inovação e progresso contínuo.

O Consultor Interno de Processos & CI trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Head de Consultoria de Processos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia global e contribuindo para os objetivos mais amplos estabelecidos no plano de 5 anos (5YP) e em outras iniciativas estratégicas de negócios.

Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos existentes, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Assegurar que as mudanças sejam sustentáveis, implementadas de forma eficaz e que seu impacto no desempenho seja mensurável.

Oferecer suporte e assistência contínua no desenvolvimento de soluções operacionais personalizadas, alinhadas ao pipeline de desenvolvimento de Operações & TI, agilizando processos, sistemas e ferramentas para criar um ambiente de trabalho mais eficiente e eficaz.

  • Medição de Desempenho : desenvolver indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar processos, desempenho de serviços e o impacto das iniciativas de melhoria, fornecendo insights aos stakeholders e apoiando ferramentas e sistemas que garantam dados provenientes de fontes válidas e integradas.

Engajar-se ativamente e apoiar a rede de colaboradores treinados para impulsionar projetos contínuos de melhoria de processos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais e entregando ganhos de desempenho mensuráveis.

Competências :

  • Influenciar de forma eficaz colegas e membros da equipe para obter apoio às iniciativas de melhoria de processos, utilizando persuasão e colaboração para garantir alinhamento e implementação bem-sucedida das mudanças.

Atividades

  1. Acolhimento e Experiência do Paciente
    • Receber os pacientes com gentileza, discrição e empatia, oferecendo um atendimento individualizado desde a chegada até a saída.
    • Antecipar necessidades e demonstrar atenção genuína aos detalhes (ex: oferecer água, ajustar temperatura da sala, observar o conforto do paciente).
    • Acompanhar o paciente nas diferentes etapas do atendimento — recepção, avaliação médica, fechamento e pós-procedimento — garantindo fluidez e encantamento em cada contato.
    • Manter a imagem e o ambiente sempre alinhados ao padrão premium da clínica.
  2. Condução Comercial e Fechamento de Procedimentos (Closer)
    • Realizar atendimento consultivo, apresentando tratamentos, valores e pacotes de forma estratégica e natural, sempre de acordo com as recomendações médicas.
    • Explicar condições comerciais e formas de pagamento com clareza e segurança.
    • Conduzir o fechamento dos contratos e recebimentos, zelando pela confidencialidade e pela experiência do cliente.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de conversão e atuar proativamente para o alcance das metas estabelecidas.
    • Manter relacionamento contínuo com pacientes para estimular novas compras, indicações e fidelização.
  3. Relacionamento e Fidelização
    • Fazer contato de pós-procedimento para garantir satisfação e identificar oportunidades de retorno.
    • Registrar observações relevantes no sistema (preferências, datas especiais, reações, observações médicas e pessoais).
    • Apoiar campanhas e eventos internos voltados à experiência e encantamento dos clientes.
    • Atuar como referência de relacionamento dentro da clínica, garantindo o padrão de excelência em todas as interações.
  4. Integração e Alinhamento Interno
    • Manter comunicação constante com médicos, equipe de atendimento e administrativo para garantir sinergia entre as áreas.
    • Participar de reuniões de performance e contribuir com feedbacks sobre comportamento e perfil dos pacientes.
    • Auxiliar na melhoria contínua dos processos de atendimento e comercial da clínica.
    • É responsável por lançamentos em sistema, abertura / fechamento de caixa e baixas de pagamentos.

  • Experiência anterior em atendimento de alto padrão, preferencialmente em clínicas médicas, estética, hotelaria de luxo ou segmento premium.
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas ou cargos com fechamento direto de serviços (closer).

description:

Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description: About BCP Securities Group Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world. Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship Position Description We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research. The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities. Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered. Main Responsibilities · Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators. · Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings. · Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets. · Track the performance and movements of financial assets. · Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts. · Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis. · Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials. · Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications. Requirements · Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory). · Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields. · Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments. · Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports. · Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail. · Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling). · Clear and structured written communication skills. · Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events. Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets. · Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters. · Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI). Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market. · Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm. · Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development. · Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Data Architect
description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization. Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora. Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies. Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions. Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Inglês intermediário, desejável avançado. 5 anos de experiência profissional em empresas multinacionais e/ou nacionais. Conhecimento de apuração de todos os tributos e entrega de obrigações acessórias munipais, estaduais e federais. Experiência em planejamento tributário. Experiência em revisão e elaboração de conciliação, análise de contas patrimoniais e resultado. Experiência no preparo de demonstrações financeiras e caderno de auditoria, demonstrações financeiras base para publicação. Conhecimento e aplicação das normas contábeis vigentes e revisão de demonstrações financeiras para a companhia de valores imobiliários. Conhecimento e aplicação normas contábeis e IFRS. Desejável conhecimento operacional módulo contábil: FI/CO - ERP SAP. Desejável conhecimento em sistema fiscal (cockpit SAP). Excel avançado. Foco no cliente internos e apoio à boa gestão da empresa. RESPONSABILIDADES: Atender amplamente a auditoria externa, analisando as solicitações, esclarecendo contabilizações, controlando cronogramas e demandas, garantindo que as demonstrações reproduzam fielmente a situação fiscal, contábil e financeira. Desenvolver equipes fiscal e contábil promovendo a sinergia das áreas, visando a ampliação do conhecimento dos colaboradores. Aprovar conciliações de todas as contas contábeis mantendo as principais em dia evitando divergências com auditoria externa ou não cumprimento das normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes. Distribuir e implementar plano de ação carta de controles internos de auditoria externa, para redução ou mitigação dos pontos no próximo período. Revisar e garantir a entrega de todas as obrigações junto aos orgãos Ferderais, Estaduais e municipais. Aprovar e acompanhar as rotinas de encerramento de exercício e melhorias em sistemas, avançando em melhores práticas de controles fiscais e contábeis. Prestar orientação contábil e fiscal para os clientes internos relativo ao caderno de auditoria, operações, legislação vigente ou demais situações técnicas para a correta aplicação e não exposição da empresa. Transmitir as informações a usuários e órgãos reguladores,. Aprovar lançamentos provenientes de reorganização societária para atendimento a normas vigentes. Elaborar comentário sobre desempenho e relatório da diretoria nas demonstrações Financeiras auditadas;
Assegurar a entrega no prazo e correta de todas as obrigações acessórias nas diversas esferas tributárias, garantindo o compliance fiscal. Assegurar que as operações fiscais da organização estejam ocorrendo em conformidade com a legislação fiscal corrente evitando autuações, multas e sanções. Analisar e buscar o aproveitamento dos créditos tributários obtidos pela empresa, por meio de compensações, restituições ou transferência para outras unidades, contribuindo para a melhora no caixa e resultado. Orientar e transmitir à equipe fiscal as mudanças ocorridas na legislação fiscal, por meio de instruções e informativos, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam atualizados. Decidir com segurança e clareza sobre questões dúbias ou polêmicas referente a tributação, por meio de análise criteriosa da legislação vigente, buscando evitar os riscos de passivo. Contribuir no adequado fechamento contábil, validando saldos contábeis a pagar e a recuperar de tributos. Identificar oportunidades de redução na carga fiscal, discutindo interna e externamente sobre possibilidades decorrentes do nosso negócio ou posicionamento dos fiscos e tribunais. Assegurar que todos os registros fiscais sejam efetuados dentro do período de competência, através da de controles das atividades e dos relatórios de apuração extraídos do sistema. Coordenar o atendimento aos processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externa ocorridos na empresa. REMUNERAÇÃO: Pacote atraente, com Bônus diferenciado e Benefícios completos!
